_about: Process families compared on the Fab Journey (roadmap area 12). Each cell is {t, refs}; every number carries a reference. A dash means no cited value: mask counts of commercial processes are not public. scripts/build_data.py bundles this into site/js/journey/data.js; tests/test_families.py checks it.

substrate.t: Silicon wafer under a grown oxide

defining.t: Dopant diffused through windows in the oxide, so every junction ends under protecting glass

devices.t: Bipolar transistors and diodes, then the first integrated circuits

defining.t: Oxide grown three times in the furnace; source and drain diffused, not implanted

devices.t: NMOS transistors, an inverter, diffused resistors, diodes and capacitors

link.label: Modern route in the Virtual Fab

defining.t: Channels stood on edge as fins, then stacked as released nanosheets wrapped by the gate

hottest.t: Spike and millisecond anneals, short enough to keep junctions shallow

masks.t: Many: fine pitches are split into self-aligned double and quadruple patterning

substrate.t: Thin silicon on a buried oxide

defining.t: Channel so thin it is fully depleted; the buried oxide isolates every transistor

devices.t: Low-power logic and RF: nFET fT 347 GHz at 22 nm

defining.t: Heterojunction bipolar transistors with a SiGe base built beside CMOS

devices.t: RF and millimetre-wave front ends with CMOS control; an open-source PDK exists

substrate.t: 4H silicon carbide wafer with an epitaxial drift layer

defining.t: Dopants hardly diffuse, so every doped region is implanted

devices.t: Kilovolt MOSFETs and Schottky diodes for power conversion

substrate.t: GaN layers grown on SiC, silicon or sapphire

defining.t: An AlGaN/GaN heterojunction whose polarisation makes a sheet of electrons without doping

devices.t: RF power amplifiers and fast power switches

defining.t: Amorphous oxide semiconductor deposited, not grown from a crystal

devices.t: Display backplanes; a bendable RISC-V processor in 0.6 µm IGZO
